shared_elements: human or humanoid figures in low relief
figures shown in profile/side view with limbs raised or extended
carved relief on a flat or curved surface
horizontal registers or bands of content
justification: Both show low-relief human-like figures in profile with raised or extended limbs arranged along a horizontal band, which is about as generic as figural relief gets. A is a continuous frieze of large interacting figures (grappling/gesturing, densely filling the field) with no writing, while B is dominated by dense rows of small script-like signs with one small isolated figure above; the relationships and compositional logic are entirely different.
